```python
from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader
from griffe.diff import find_breakages

loader = GriffeLoader()

# Load package at v1.0.0 and HEAD using git
old = loader.load("mypkg", git_sha="v1.0.0")
new = loader.load("mypkg", git_sha="HEAD")

# Find and print all breakages
for breakage in find_breakages(old, new):
    print(breakage)
```
